newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to auction T$40 bln 15-yr bond in January.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to auction T$40 bln 15-yr bond in January.

text.p: Taiwan's finance ministry confirmed on Friday it would auction T$40 billion worth of 15-year government bonds on January 17.
The bonds will have a coupon rate of 6.900 percent, the ministry said in a statement.
The issuing date is January 21, it said.
Up to T$800 million of the bonds will be sold through post offices, reflecting the government's desire to tap the capital of small investors.
As an added incentive, the ministry said purchasers who buy more than T$100,000 of the issue would receive a telephone card of unspecified value.
The ministry on Tuesday auctioned T$50 billion in 10-year 86/4 government bonds.
